radiusSource: Radius 24 +/- 15 solar radii from Comerón et al. (2003), A&A 400, 137, section 3.1: T_eff = 15,000 K, uncertain by about 3,000 K, from its B-V colour through the colour, temperature and bolometric correction relations of Castelli (1999) (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361:20021909). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
